query: WITH source_pages AS (SELECT s.source_page FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK'), expected AS (SELECT generate_series(454,925) AS source_page) SELECT json_build_object('pdf_last_page',925,'source_pages_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM source_pages),'source_pages_454_925',(SELECT count(*) FROM source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 454 AND 925),'missing_pages_454_925',(SELECT count(*) FROM expected e LEFT JOIN source_pages s ON s.source_page=e.source_page WHERE s.source_page IS NULL),'source_page_min',(SELECT min(source_page) FROM source_pages),'source_page_max',(SELECT max(source_page) FROM source_pages),'facts_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts),'notes_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes),'mcqs_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs),'mcq_options_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options),'verifications_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications),'flashcards_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards),'search_documents_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents)) AS source_coverage LIMIT 1;
